column1: # ADCP validation manifest — one row per docking job.
#   pdb     RCSB entry of the holo complex (lower case)
#   apo     RCSB entry of the apo receptor for cross-docking, or "-"
#   length  peptide length in residues, AS PUBLISHED. prepare_target.sh resolves
#           the peptide chain from the structure and asserts this number — a
#           mismatch means the wrong chain was picked, and it fails loudly.
#   ref     published ADCP result, as rank=value pairs. "-" where the ADCP
#           authors never published a per-target number.
#   source  paper and table the ref came from
# Sets A, B and C were transcribed from the published tables and carry a
# reference value FOR EVERY TARGET AND EVERY RANK. Sets D-G are appended by
# acquire_sets.py, which validates the published counts before writing.
# --- A. long peptides, 16-20 aa (11) — Bioinformatics 2019, Table 4 ----------
# group I: HIV integrase binders; II: SFTI-1 (backbone AND disulfide);
